items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى رُوحِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْأَرْوَاحِ، وَعَلَى جَسَدِهِ فِي الْأَجْسَادِ، وَعَلَى قَبْرِهِ فِي الْقُبُورِ، وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the soul of our master Muhammad among souls, and upon his body among bodies, and upon his grave among graves, and upon his family and companions, and grant peace.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala ruhi Sayyidina Muhammadin fil-arwahi, wa 'ala jasadihi fil-ajsadi, wa 'ala qabrihi fil-quburi, wa 'ala alihi wa sahbihi wa sallim.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كُلَّمَا ذَكَرَهُ الذَّاكِرُونَ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad every time the rememberers remember him.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin kullama dhakarahudh-dhakirun.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كُلَّمَا غَفَلَ عَنْ ذِكْرِهِ الْغَافِلُونَ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad every time the heedless are heedless of remembering him.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin kullama ghafala 'an dhikrihil-ghafilun.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ أُمَّهَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ، صَلَاةً وَسَلَامًا لَا يُحْصَى عَدَدُهُمَا وَلَا يُقْطَعُ مَدَدُهُمَا.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings, peace, and grace upon our master Muhammad, the unlettered Prophet, and his wives the Mothers of the Believers, and his descendants and the People of his House — a blessing and a peace whose number cannot be counted and whose extent cannot be cut off.
items.translit: Allahumma salli wa sallim wa barik 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadinin-nabiyyil-ummiyyi wa azwajihi ummahatil-mu'minina wa dhurriyyatihi wa ahli baytihi, salatan wa salaman la yuhsa 'adaduhuma wa la yuqta'u madaduhuma.

lessons.title: The Wasila and the Praised Station

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ وَأَحْصَاهُ كِتَابُكَ، صَلَاةً تَكُونُ لَكَ رِضًا، وَلِحَقِّهِ أَدَاءً، وَآتِهِ الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَالدَّرَجَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ الْمَقَامَ الْمَحْمُودَ الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا مَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ، وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ إِخْوَانِهِ مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your knowledge encompasses and Your Book has counted, a blessing that is pleasing to You and a fulfillment of his due, and grant him the wasila, the excellence, and the elevated rank, and raise him to the Praised Station which You promised him, and reward him on our behalf as he deserves, and upon all his brethren among the prophets, the truthful, the martyrs, and the righteous.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada ma ahata bihi 'ilmuka wa ahsahu kitabuka, salatan takunu laka ridhan, wa li-haqqihi ada'an, wa atihil-wasilata wal-fadhilata wad-darajatar-rafi'ata, wab'ath-hul-maqamal-mahmudal-ladhi wa'adtahu, wajzihi 'anna ma huwa ahluhu, wa 'ala jami'i ikhwanihi minan-nabiyyina was-siddiqina wash-shuhada'i was-salihin.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَنْزِلْهُ الْمَنْزِلَ الْمُكَرَّمَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and settle him in the honored abode on the Day of Resurrection.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa anzilhul-manzilal-mukarrama yawmal-qiyamah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَتَوِّجْهُ بِتَاجِ الْعِزِّ وَالرِّضَا وَالْكَرَامَةِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, and crown him with the crown of honor, pleasure, and nobility.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa tawwijhu bi-tajil-'izzi war-ridha wal-karamah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ آتِ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا أَفْضَلَ مَا سَأَلَكَ لِنَفْسِهِ، وَآتِ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا أَفْضَلَ مَا سَأَلَكَ لَهُ أَحَدٌ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، وَآتِ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا أَفْضَلَ مَا أَنْتَ مَسْئُولٌ لَهُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ.
items.en: O Allah, grant our master Muhammad the best of what he has asked of You for himself, and grant our master Muhammad the best of what anyone of Your creation has asked of You for him, and grant our master Muhammad the best of what You will be asked for him until the Day of Resurrection.
items.translit: Allahumma ati Sayyidana Muhammadan afdhala ma sa'alaka li-nafsihi, wa ati Sayyidana Muhammadan afdhala ma sa'alaka lahu ahadun min khalqika, wa ati Sayyidana Muhammadan afdhala ma anta mas'ulun lahu ila yawmil-qiyamah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَسَيِّدِنَا آدَمَ وَسَيِّدِنَا نُوحٍ وَسَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَسَيِّدِنَا مُوسَى وَسَيِّدِنَا عِيسَى وَمَا بَيْنَهُمْ مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالْمُرْسَلِينَ، صَلَوَاتُ اللَّهِ وَسَلَامُهُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَجْمَعِينَ. (ثَلَاثًا)
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and our master Adam and our master Nuh and our master Ibrahim and our master Musa and our master 'Isa and all the prophets and messengers between them — the blessings and peace of Allah be upon them all. (recited three times)
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa Sayyidina Adama wa Sayyidina Nuhin wa Sayyidina Ibrahima wa Sayyidina Musa wa Sayyidina 'Isa wa ma baynahum minan-nabiyyina wal-mursalin, salawatullahi wa salamuhu 'alayhim ajma'in. (thalathan)

items.ar: عَدَدَ مَا عَلِمْتَ وَمِلْءَ مَا عَلِمْتَ وَزِنَةَ مَا عَلِمْتَ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِكَ.
items.en: as many as what You know, and filling what You know, and the weight of what You know, and the ink of Your words.
items.translit: 'Adada ma 'alimta wa mil'a ma 'alimta wa zinata ma 'alimta wa midada kalimatik.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً مَوْصُولَةً بِالْمَزِيدِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, a blessing joined with increase.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin salatan mawsulatan bil-mazid.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً لَا تَنْقَطِعُ أَبَدَ الْآبَادِ وَلَا تَبِيدُ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, a blessing that never ceases, for ever and ever, and never perishes.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin salatan la tanqati'u abadal-abadi wa la tabid.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ الصَّلَاةَ الَّتِي صَلَّيْتَ عَلَيْهِ، وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ السَّلَامَ الَّذِي سَلَّمْتَ عَلَيْهِ، وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا مَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ.
items.en: O Allah, send upon our master Muhammad the blessing which You have sent upon him, and grant our master Muhammad the peace which You have granted him, and reward him on our behalf as he deserves.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadinis-salatal-lati sallayta 'alayhi, wa sallim 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadinis-salamal-ladhi sallamta 'alayhi, wajzihi 'anna ma huwa ahluh.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً تُرْضِيكَ وَتُرْضِيهِ وَتَرْضَى بِهَا عَنَّا، وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا مَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ.
items.en: O Allah, send upon our master Muhammad a blessing that pleases You and pleases him and through which You are pleased with us, and reward him on our behalf as he deserves.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin salatan turdhika wa turdhihi wa tardha biha 'anna, wajzihi 'anna ma huwa ahluh.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا فِي عِلْمِ اللَّهِ صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً بِدَوَامِ مُلْكِ اللَّهِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as is in the knowledge of Allah, an enduring blessing lasting as long as the dominion of Allah endures.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada ma fi 'ilmillahi salatan da'imatan bidawami mulkillah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي الْعَالَمِينَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad just as You sent blessings upon our master Ibrahim, and bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad just as You blessed the family of our master Ibrahim, in all the worlds. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin kama sallayta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima, wa barik 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin kama barakta 'ala ali Sayyidina Ibrahima fil-'alamina, innaka Hamidun Majid.

items.ar: عَدَدَ خَلْقِكَ وَرِضَا نَفْسِكَ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِكَ، وَعَدَدَ مَا ذَكَرَكَ بِهِ خَلْقُكَ فِيمَا مَضَى، وَعَدَدَ مَا هُمْ ذَاكِرُوكَ بِهِ فِيمَا بَقِيَ، فِي كُلِّ سَنَةٍ وَشَهْرٍ وَجُمُعَةٍ وَيَوْمٍ وَلَيْلَةٍ وَسَاعَةٍ مِنَ السَّاعَاتِ، وَشَمٍّ وَنَفَسٍ وَطَرْفَةٍ وَلَمْحَةٍ مِنَ الْأَبَدِ إِلَى الْأَبَدِ، وَأَبَدِ الدُّنْيَا وَأَبَدِ الْآخِرَةِ، وَأَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ، لَا يَنْقَطِعُ أَوَّلُهُ وَلَا يَنْفَدُ آخِرُهُ.
items.en: as many as Your creation, and to the extent of Your own pleasure, and the weight of Your Throne, and the ink of Your words, and as many times as Your creation has remembered You in what has passed, and as many times as they will remember You in what remains, in every year, month, week, day, night, and hour of the hours, and every breath, moment, and glance, from eternity to eternity, the eternity of this world and the eternity of the Hereafter, and more than that — without its beginning ceasing or its end running out.
items.translit: 'Adada khalqika wa ridha'a nafsika wa zinata 'arshika wa midada kalimatika, wa 'adada ma dhakaraka bihi khalquka fima madha, wa 'adada ma hum dhakiruka bihi fima baqiya, fi kulli sanatin wa shahrin wa jumu'atin wa yawmin wa laylatin wa sa'atin minas-sa'at, wa shammin wa nafasin wa tarfatin wa lamhatin minal-abadi ilal-abad, wa abadid-dunya wa abadil-akhirah, wa akthara min dhalika, la yanqati'u awwaluhu wa la yanfadu akhiruh.

lessons.title: To the Measure of Your Love for Him

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَى قَدْرِ حُبِّكَ فِيهِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad to the extent of Your love for him.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'ala qadri hubbika fih.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَى قَدْرِ عِنَايَتِكَ بِهِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad to the extent of Your care for him.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'ala qadri 'inayatika bih.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ وَمِقْدَارِهِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the true measure of his worth and standing.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin haqqa qadrihi wa miqdarih.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً تُنَجِّينَا بِهَا مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْأَهْوَالِ وَالْآفَاتِ، وَتَقْضِي لَنَا بِهَا جَمِيعَ الْحَاجَاتِ، وَتُطَهِّرُنَا بِهَا مِنْ جَمِيعِ السَّيِّئَاتِ، وَتَرْفَعُنَا بِهَا عَلَى الدَّرَجَاتِ، وَتُبَلِّغُنَا بِهَا أَقْصَى الْغَايَاتِ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْخَيْرَاتِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ وَبَعْدَ الْمَمَاتِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, a blessing by which You save us from all terrors and afflictions, and by which You fulfill for us all our needs, and by which You purify us from all sins, and by which You raise us in rank, and by which You bring us to the utmost degree of every good in this life and after death.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin salatan tunajjina biha min jami'il-ahwali wal-afati, wa taqdhi lana biha jami'al-hajati, wa tutahhiruna biha min jami'is-sayyi'ati, wa tarfa'una biha 'alad-darajati, wa tuballighuna biha aqsal-ghayati min jami'il-khayrati fil-hayati wa ba'dal-mamat.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةَ الرِّضَا، وَارْضَ عَنْ أَصْحَابِهِ رِضَا الرِّضَا.
items.en: O Allah, send upon our master Muhammad the blessing of contentment, and be pleased with his companions with the utmost pleasure.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin salatar-ridha, war-dha 'an ashabihi ridhar-ridha.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ أَوْرَاقِ الزَّيْتُونِ وَجَمِيعِ الثِّمَارِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master and mawla Muhammad as many as the leaves of the olive tree and all the fruits.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina wa Mawlana Muhammadin 'adada awraqiz-zaytuni wa jami'ith-thimar.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا كَانَ وَمَا يَكُونُ وَعَدَدَ مَا أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلُ وَأَضَاءَ عَلَيْهِ النَّهَارُ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master and mawla Muhammad as many as what has been and what will be, and as many times as night has darkened over it and day has shone upon it.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina wa Mawlana Muhammadin 'adada ma kana wa ma yakunu wa 'adada ma azlama 'alayhil-laylu wa adha'a 'alayhin-nahar.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ عَدَدَ أَنْفَاسِ أُمَّتِهِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon his wives and his descendants as many as the breaths of his nation.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala azwajihi wa dhurriyyatihi 'adada anfasi ummatih.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بِبَرَكَةِ الصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ اجْعَلْنَا بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْفَائِزِينَ، وَعَلَى حَوْضِهِ مِنَ الْوَارِدِينَ الشَّارِبِينَ، وَبِسُنَّتِهِ وَطَاعَتِهِ مِنَ الْعَامِلِينَ، وَلَا تَحُلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِوَالِدَيْنَا وَلِجَمِيعِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
items.en: O Allah, by the blessing of sending prayers upon him, make us, through sending prayers upon him, among the successful, and at his Pool among those who arrive and drink, and by his way and obedience to him among those who act accordingly, and do not come between us and him on the Day of Resurrection, O Lord of the worlds, and forgive us and our parents and all the Muslims, and all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.
items.translit: Allahumma bi-barakatis-salati 'alayhij-'alna bis-salati 'alayhi minal-fa'izin, wa 'ala hawdihi minal-waridinash-sharibin, wa bi-sunnatihi wa ta'atihi minal-'amilin, wa la tahul baynana wa baynahu yawmal-qiyamati ya Rabbal-'alamin, waghfir lana wa li-walidayna wa li-jami'il-muslimin, wal-hamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alamin.

lessons.title: Master of the First and the Last

items.ar: صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً مُسْتَمِرَّةَ الدَّوَامِ عَلَى مَرِّ اللَّيَالِي وَالْأَيَّامِ، فَهُوَ سَيِّدُ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَالْآخِرِينَ، وَأَفْضَلُ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَالْآخِرِينَ، عَلَيْهِ أَفْضَلُ صَلَاةِ الْمُصَلِّينَ، وَأَزْكَى سَلَامِ الْمُسَلِّمِينَ، وَأَطْيَبُ ذِكْرِ الذَّاكِرِينَ.
items.en: May Allah's blessings be upon him and upon his family, an enduring blessing continuing through the passing of nights and days. For he is the master of the first and the last, and the most excellent of the first and the last. Upon him be the best blessing of those who bless, the purest greeting of those who greet, and the goodliest remembrance of those who remember.
items.translit: Sallallahu 'alayhi wa 'ala alihi salatan da'imatan mustamirratad-dawami 'ala marril-layali wal-ayyam, fahuwa sayyidul-awwalina wal-akhirin, wa afdhalul-awwalina wal-akhirin, 'alayhi afdhalu salatil-musallin, wa azka salamil-musallimin, wa atyabu dhikridh-dhakirin.

items.ar: وَأَفْضَلُ صَلَوَاتِ اللَّهِ، وَأَحْسَنُ صَلَوَاتِ اللَّهِ، وَأَجَلُّ صَلَوَاتِ اللَّهِ، وَأَجْمَلُ صَلَوَاتِ اللَّهِ، وَأَكْمَلُ صَلَوَاتِ اللَّهِ، وَأَسْبَغُ صَلَوَاتِ اللَّهِ، وَأَتَمُّ صَلَوَاتِ اللَّهِ، وَأَظْهَرُ صَلَوَاتِ اللَّهِ، وَأَعْظَمُ صَلَوَاتِ اللَّهِ، وَأَزْكَى صَلَوَاتِ اللَّهِ، وَأَطْيَبُ صَلَوَاتِ اللَّهِ، وَأَبْرَكُ صَلَوَاتِ اللَّهِ.
items.en: And the most excellent of Allah's blessings, and the finest of Allah's blessings, and the greatest of Allah's blessings, and the most beautiful of Allah's blessings, and the most complete of Allah's blessings, and the most abundant of Allah's blessings, and the most perfect of Allah's blessings, and the most manifest of Allah's blessings, and the mightiest of Allah's blessings, and the purest of Allah's blessings, and the goodliest of Allah's blessings, and the most blessed of Allah's blessings.
items.translit: Wa afdhalu salawatillah, wa ahsanu salawatillah, wa ajallu salawatillah, wa ajmalu salawatillah, wa akmalu salawatillah, wa asbaghu salawatillah, wa atammu salawatillah, wa azharu salawatillah, wa a'zamu salawatillah, wa azka salawatillah, wa atyabu salawatillah, wa abraku salawatillah.

items.ar: وَأَزْكَى صَلَوَاتِ اللَّهِ، وَأَنْمَى صَلَوَاتِ اللَّهِ، وَأَوْفَى صَلَوَاتِ اللَّهِ، وَأَسْنَى صَلَوَاتِ اللَّهِ، وَأَعْلَى صَلَوَاتِ اللَّهِ، وَأَكْثَرُ صَلَوَاتِ اللَّهِ، وَأَجْمَعُ صَلَوَاتِ اللَّهِ، وَأَعَمُّ صَلَوَاتِ اللَّهِ، وَأَدْوَمُ صَلَوَاتِ اللَّهِ، وَأَبْقَى صَلَوَاتِ اللَّهِ، وَأَعَزُّ صَلَوَاتِ اللَّهِ، وَأَرْفَعُ صَلَوَاتِ اللَّهِ، وَأَعْظَمُ صَلَوَاتِ اللَّهِ.
items.en: And the purest of Allah's blessings, and the most flourishing of Allah's blessings, and the most complete of Allah's blessings, and the most exalted of Allah's blessings, and the highest of Allah's blessings, and the most abundant of Allah's blessings, and the most all-encompassing of Allah's blessings, and the most universal of Allah's blessings, and the most enduring of Allah's blessings, and the most lasting of Allah's blessings, and the mightiest of Allah's blessings, and the most elevated of Allah's blessings, and the greatest of Allah's blessings.
items.translit: Wa azka salawatillah, wa anma salawatillah, wa awfa salawatillah, wa asna salawatillah, wa a'la salawatillah, wa aktharu salawatillah, wa ajma'u salawatillah, wa a'ammu salawatillah, wa adwamu salawatillah, wa abqa salawatillah, wa a'azzu salawatillah, wa arfa'u salawatillah, wa a'zamu salawatillah.

items.ar: عَلَى أَفْضَلِ خَلْقِ اللَّهِ، وَأَحْسَنِ خَلْقِ اللَّهِ، وَأَجَلِّ خَلْقِ اللَّهِ، وَأَكْرَمِ خَلْقِ اللَّهِ، وَأَجْمَلِ خَلْقِ اللَّهِ، وَأَكْمَلِ خَلْقِ اللَّهِ، وَأَتَمِّ خَلْقِ اللَّهِ، وَأَعْظَمِ خَلْقِ اللَّهِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ.
items.en: upon the most excellent of Allah's creation, and the best of Allah's creation, and the most exalted of Allah's creation, and the most noble of Allah's creation, and the most beautiful of Allah's creation, and the most complete of Allah's creation, and the most perfect of Allah's creation, and the greatest of Allah's creation in Allah's sight.
items.translit: 'Ala afdhali khalqillah, wa ahsani khalqillah, wa ajalli khalqillah, wa akrami khalqillah, wa ajmali khalqillah, wa akmali khalqillah, wa atammi khalqillah, wa a'zami khalqillahi 'indallah.

items.ar: رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ، وَحَبِيبِ اللَّهِ، وَصَفِيِّ اللَّهِ، وَنَجِيِّ اللَّهِ، وَخَلِيلِ اللَّهِ، وَوَلِيِّ اللَّهِ، وَأَمِينِ اللَّهِ.
items.en: the Messenger of Allah, the Prophet of Allah, the Beloved of Allah, the Chosen One of Allah, the Confidant of Allah, the Intimate Friend of Allah, the Ally of Allah, and the Trustee of Allah.
items.translit: Rasulillah, Nabiyyillah, wa Habibillah, wa Safiyyillah, wa Najiyyillah, wa Khalilillah, wa Waliyyillah, wa Aminillah.

lessons.title: The Chosen One of Allah's Messengers

items.ar: وَخِيَرَةِ اللَّهِ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ، وَنُخْبَةِ اللَّهِ مِنْ بَرِيَّتِهِ، وَصَفْوَةِ اللَّهِ مِنْ أَنْبِيَائِهِ، وَعُرْوَةِ اللَّهِ، وَعِصْمَةِ اللَّهِ، وَنِعْمَةِ اللَّهِ، وَمِفْتَاحِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ.
items.en: and the choicest of Allah's creation, and the elect of Allah among His creatures, and the elite of Allah among His prophets, and the firm handhold of Allah, and the protection of Allah, and the favor of Allah, and the key to Allah's mercy.
items.translit: Wa khiyaratillahi min khalqihi, wa nukhbatillahi min bariyyatihi, wa safwatillahi min anbiya'ihi, wa 'urwatillah, wa 'ismatillah, wa ni'matillah, wa miftahi rahmatillah.

items.ar: الْمُخْتَارِ مِنْ رُسُلِ اللَّهِ، الْمُنْتَخَبِ مِنْ خَلْقِ اللَّهِ الْفَائِزِ بِالْمَطْلَبِ فِي الْمَرْحَبِ وَالْمَرْغَبِ، الْمُخْلَصِ فِيمَا وُهِبَ، أَكْرَمِ مَبْعُوثٍ.
items.en: the chosen one of Allah's messengers, the selected one of Allah's creation, the one who attained his goal in welcome and desire, the sincere one in what he was granted, the most noble of those sent.
items.translit: Al-mukhtari min rusulillah, al-muntakhabi min khalqillahil-fa'izi bil-matlabi fil-marhabi wal-marghab, al-mukhlasi fima wuhib, akrami mab'uth.

items.ar: أَصْدَقِ قَائِلٍ، أَنْجَحِ شَافِعٍ، أَفْضَلِ مُشَفَّعٍ، الْأَمِينِ فِيمَا اسْتُودِعَ، الصَّادِقِ فِيمَا بَلَّغَ، الْمُطَّلِعِ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهِ بِمَا حُمِّلَ.
items.en: the truest of speakers, the most successful of intercessors, the best of those granted intercession, the trustworthy one regarding what was entrusted to him, the truthful one in what he conveyed, the one who carried out his Lord's command in what he was charged with.
items.translit: Asdaqi qa'ilin, anjahi shafi'in, afdhali mushaffa'in, al-amini fimas-tudi'a, as-sadiqi fima ballagha, al-muttali'i bi-amri rabbihi bima hummil.

items.ar: أَقْرَبِ رُسُلِ اللَّهِ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَسِيلَةً، وَأَعْظَمِهِمْ غَدًا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ مَنْزِلَةً وَفَضِيلَةً، وَأَكْرَمِ أَنْبِيَاءِ اللَّهِ الْكِرَامِ الصَّفْوَةِ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَأَحَبِّهِمْ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَأَقْرَبِهِمْ زُلْفَى لَدَى اللَّهِ.
items.en: the closest of Allah's messengers to Allah in access, and the greatest of them tomorrow in rank and merit before Allah, and the most noble of Allah's noble, elect prophets, and the most beloved of them to Allah and the nearest of them in closeness to Allah.
items.translit: Aqrabi rusulillahi ilallahi wasilatan, wa a'zamihim ghadan 'indallahi manzilatan wa fadhilatan, wa akrami anbiya'illahil-kiramis-safwati 'alallah, wa ahabbihim ilallahi wa aqrabihim zulfa ladallah.

items.ar: وَأَكْرَمِ الْخَلْقِ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَأَحَظِّهِمْ وَأَرْضَاهُمْ لَدَى اللَّهِ، وَأَعْلَاهُمْ عِنْدَ النَّاسِ قَدْرًا، وَأَعْظَمِهِمْ مَحَلًّا، وَأَكْمَلِهِمْ مَحَاسِنَ وَفَضْلًا، وَأَفْضَلِ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ دَرَجَةً.
items.en: and the most noble of creation before Allah, and the most favored and most pleasing of them to Allah, and the highest of them in standing among people, and the greatest of them in rank, and the most complete of them in virtues and merit, and the most excellent of the prophets in rank.
items.translit: Wa akramil-khalqi 'alallah, wa ahazhzhihim wa ardhahum ladallah, wa a'lahum 'indan-nasi qadran, wa a'zamihim mahallan, wa akmalihim mahasina wa fadhlan, wa afdhalil-anbiya'i darajatan.
